from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, json, subprocess

root = Path('products/services/merchant-v1-group-id-sample/runnable-controls')
record = json.loads((root / 'verification.json').read_text())
for name in ('check.py', 'pass.csv', 'fail.csv'):
    assert hashlib.sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() == record['files'][name], name
for fixture, code, conflicts in [('pass.csv', 0, {}), ('fail.csv', 1, {'linen-shirt': ['G1', 'G2']})]:
    result = subprocess.run(['python3', 'check.py', fixture], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    assert result.returncode == code, fixture
    assert json.loads(result.stdout) == {'conflicting_families': conflicts}, fixture
    print(json.dumps({'fixture': str(root / fixture), 'exit_code': result.returncode, 'result': json.loads(result.stdout)}))
print('Runner and both fixtures match the committed verification hashes.')
